lines.t: Joy, oh joy, where have you gone?
Joy, oh joy, why do you seem so far?
Moments of peace and grace
Are whispers on the wind.
The years pass by, the days move on,
But this world has never felt like home.
There’s a disappointment I carry quietly,
With life, with the world, with all I’ve seen.
Longing for a world made right.
Joy, oh joy, where have you gone?
Why do you always seem so far?
The years have left their weight on me,
More than these eyes were meant to see.
Joy, oh joy, why do you stay
Just out of reach along the way?
I’ve never felt I quite belonged,
So I walk this road on my own.
There He is upon the mount,
Teaching while the people gather near.
I stay beneath the distant hill,
Listening quietly from here.
The years have drawn me inward still,
And taught me how to stand apart.
So I remain a little far,
With all this weight around my heart.
Joy, oh joy, where have you gone?
Why do you always seem so far?
The years have left their weight on me,
More than these eyes were meant to see.
Joy, oh joy, why do you stay
Just out of reach along the way?
I’ve never felt I quite belonged,
So I walk this road on my own.
I walk alone beyond the noise,
With sorrow buried deep.
And when He finds me on the road,
I lower my head and weep.
His loving eyes rest upon me,
His gentle hands reach out.
I feel the rushing of the wind,
The wind of His love holding me.
I cannot lift my head.
I feel unworthy standing there.
Doesn’t He feel the longing in me—
The longing to come home?
Look upon me, heal what’s broken,
Gather every scattered part.
Hold me close and bring me home,
Where life is pure and all is right.
Joy, oh joy,
I wait for You.
